title_as_printed: Measured changes Delta rho in density and calculated densities rho, molar volumes Vm, apparent molar volumes V_phi, and average isothermal compressibilities kappa_T, of salt solutions. m0 = 1 mol/kg, rho0 = 1 g/cm3, Vm0 = 1 cm3/mol

footnotes_as_printed.a: No value of V_phi was tabulated when p2 was smaller than the vapor pressure of pure water at that temperature. (letter printed on the V_phi/Vm0 column header)
footnotes_as_printed.b: kappa_T was calculated from equation (3) using rho and Delta rho from the line on which kappa_T is given and the results from the previous line. If Delta p2 was less than 1 MPa, kappa_T was not calculated. (letter printed on the kappa_T column header)

pressure_note: p1 = pressure at which pure-water baseline and solution were compared (Delta rho = solution at p2 minus pure water at p1, per text); p2 = pressure of the solution measurement; absolute pressure, near saturation; text gives vapour pressures in Table 1

T.what: printed only on the first row of each block; blank cells mean same T as the row above

value.what: density of solution at p2 minus density of pure water at p1 (rho0 = 1 g/cm3)

value2.what: calculated density of the solution at p2 (from Delta rho and Haar et al. water density)

skip_rows.reason: salt label rows NaCl, KCl, CaCl2

extra_unmapped: Vphi/Vm0 (calculated apparent molar volume of solute)
conversion_needs: blank T cell = previous T (forward fill)
Vm0 = 1 cm3/mol, so Vm/Vm0 is in cm3/mol
notes: Only Delta rho is directly measured; rho, Vm, Vphi, kappa_T are calculated by the authors and are listed as printed. T is the mean temperature of each block of rows. Printed oddities kept: T 623.090 (page 5); Vphi printed as '-243 9' (decimal point missing in the scan, written -243.9); rho 0.819890 (6 decimals) at 623.10 K KCl 3.0000; kappa values printed as integers 20, 18, 1800 (CaCl2 0.225, 642.83 K) and 11, 10, 11, 10 (0.487, 642.89 K) kept; two rows (CaCl2 3.234, 642.85 K, p2 19.015 and 19.96) have small numbers 0.056 and 0.0024 printed shifted left toward the Vphi column but they are written in the kappa_T column. Consistency check rho/rho0 - Delta rho/rho0 (= water density at T, p1) within a block disagrees for two printed values: CaCl2 3.234 623.13 K first row rho 0.97349 (neighbours imply 0.97394) and CaCl2 0.225 642.89 K first row rho 0.56648 (neighbours imply 0.56603); both are as printed in the scan (zoomed).
